mainEntity.name: How do you optimize a Google Business Profile for local visibility in Houston?

acceptedAnswer.text: To optimize a Google Business Profile for local visibility in Houston, we start by ensuring all business information is accurate, complete, and consistent across all platforms. This includes precise business name, address, phone number, and website. We then select relevant categories, add high-quality photos, and write a compelling business description incorporating Houston-specific keywords where appropriate. Encouraging and responding to customer reviews is crucial, as is regularly posting updates and offers. Consistent monitoring and refinement of these elements help maximize local search performance.
acceptedAnswer.description: We optimize Google Business Profiles for Houston by ensuring accurate business information, relevant categories, high-quality photos, engaging descriptions, and active review management.
